when:
has(event.row.before) && event.row.before != null
&& ("effective_range" in event.row.before
||"exit_ground" in event.row.before
||"exit_facts" in event.row.before)
effect:
movements.filter(
  m,
  m.reference != null
  &&m.reference.startsWith("exit:" + event.row.id + ":")
  &&!((event.row.exit_facts != null
  &&event.row.effective_range.to != null
    ?string(event.row.effective_range.to) + "/"
    + (has(event.row.exit_ground) && event.row.exit_ground != null
      ?event.row.exit_ground
      :"")
    :"")
  !=""
  &&m.reference.endsWith(
    ":"
    + (event.row.exit_facts != null
    &&event.row.effective_range.to != null
      ?string(event.row.effective_range.to) + "/"
      + (has(event.row.exit_ground) && event.row.exit_ground != null
        ?event.row.exit_ground
        :"")
      :""
  ) )
) ).map(
  m,
  {
    "collection": "leave_catalog_entry",
    "operation": "delete",
    "data": {"target": [m.id]}
  }
)
+tasks.filter(
  t,
  t.facts != null && has(t.facts.exit_key)
  &&t.facts.exit_key
  != (event.row.exit_facts != null
  &&event.row.effective_range.to != null
    ?string(event.row.effective_range.to) + "/"
    + (has(event.row.exit_ground) && event.row.exit_ground != null
      ?event.row.exit_ground
      :"")
    :""
) ).map(
  t,
  {
    "collection": "regulatory_task",
    "operation": "update",
    "data": {
      "target": [t.id],
      "set": {
        "state": "DISMISSED",
        "dismiss_reason": "The exit it answered was changed on "
        +event.day
        +".",
        "occurrence_key": t.occurrence_key + ":withdrawn:" + event.day
      }
    }
  }
)
+exit_pay.filter(
  e,
  e.facts != null && has(e.facts.source)
  &&string(e.facts.source).startsWith("exit:" + event.row.id + ":")
  &&!((event.row.effective_range.to != null
  &&has(event.row.exit_ground)
  &&event.row.exit_ground != null
  &&event.row.exit_ground != ""
    ?string(event.row.effective_range.to) + "/" + event.row.exit_ground
    :"")
  !=""
  &&string(e.facts.source).endsWith(
    ":"
    + (event.row.effective_range.to != null
    &&has(event.row.exit_ground)
    &&event.row.exit_ground != null
    &&event.row.exit_ground != ""
      ?string(event.row.effective_range.to) + "/"
      +event.row.exit_ground
      :""
  ) )
) ).map(
  e,
  {
    "collection": "adhoc_catalog_entry",
    "operation": "delete",
    "data": {"target": [e.id]}
  }
)

catalogues.filter(
  c,
  (has(event.row.exit_facts.annual_leave_on_exit)
    ?event.row.exit_facts.annual_leave_on_exit == "ENCASH"
    :!grounds.exists(
      g,
      has(g.rules.kinds)
      &&g.rules.kinds.exists(
        k,
        k.code
        == (has(event.row.exit_ground) && event.row.exit_ground != null
          ?event.row.exit_ground
          :"")
        &&has(k.encash_annual_leave)
        &&k.encash_annual_leave == false
      )
    ))
  &&has(c.entitlement)
  &&c.entitlement != null
  &&has(c.entitlement.days)
  &&!movements.exists(
    m,
    m.reference
    =="exit:" + event.row.id + ":" + c.code + ":"
    +string(event.row.effective_range.to)
    +"/"
    + (has(event.row.exit_ground) && event.row.exit_ground != null
      ?event.row.exit_ground
      :""
  ) )
).map(
  c,
  {
    "collection": "leave_catalog_entry",
    "operation": "create",
    "data": {
      "catalog_id": c.id,
      "employment_id": event.row.id,
      "occurred_on": event.row.effective_range.to,
      "activity": "ENCASHMENT",
      "reference": "exit:" + event.row.id + ":" + c.code + ":"
      +string(event.row.effective_range.to)
      +"/"
      + (has(event.row.exit_ground) && event.row.exit_ground != null
        ?event.row.exit_ground
        :""),
      "days": max(
        0.0,
        sum(
          event.leave_balances.filter(b, b.code == c.code).map(
            b,
            b.remaining
          )
        )
      )
    }
  }
).filter(
  w,
  w.data.days > 0
)

classes.filter(
  c,
  !entries.exists(
    e,
    lineage.exists(l, l.id == e.catalog_id && l.code == c.code)
    && (e.facts == null || !has(e.facts.source)
    ||!string(e.facts.source).startsWith("exit:")
    ||e.facts.source
    =="exit:" + event.row.id + ":" + c.code + ":"
    +string(event.row.effective_range.to)
    +"/"
    +event.row.exit_ground
  ) )
).map(
  c,
  {
    "collection": "adhoc_catalog_entry",
    "operation": "create",
    "data": {
      "catalog_id": c.id,
      "employment_id": event.row.id,
      "occurred_on": event.row.effective_range.to,
      "facts": {
        "source": "exit:" + event.row.id + ":" + c.code + ":"
        +string(event.row.effective_range.to)
        +"/"
        +event.row.exit_ground
      }
    }
  }
)

definition.description: Appoint one or more data protection officers accountable for compliance with the Act and register the appointment and the officer's business contact with the Commissioner (SPDP) within 21 days of the appointment. Required where the employer processes the personal data of more than 20,000 data subjects, sensitive personal data including financial information of more than 10,000, or carries on regular and systematic monitoring (entity fact pdpa_dpo_required); payroll holds every employee's financial data, so more than 10,000 employees raises it too. Raised when the entity is recorded.

name: Appoint and register a data protection officer (scope reached)

references.title: Personal Data Protection Act 2010 s.12A as inserted by Act A1727 (https://lom.agc.gov.my/ilims/upload/portal/akta/outputaktap/3301061_BI/Act%20709%20(Reprint%202026).pdf); Guideline on the Appointment of Data Protection Officer paras 4.2, 7.1 (https://www.pdp.gov.my/ppdpv1/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/GP_DPO_ENG.pdf, read 2026-10-07).

definition.description: The s.12A duty when the entity comes within the Commissioner's conditions after it is recorded: raised when its pdpa_dpo_required fact is set to true; due 21 days later.
definition.when:
row != null && has(row.before) && row.before != null
&&"facts" in row.before
&&has(row.facts)
&&row.facts != null
&&has(row.facts.pdpa_dpo_required)
&&row.facts.pdpa_dpo_required == true
&&!(row.before.facts != null && has(row.before.facts.pdpa_dpo_required)
&&row.before.facts.pdpa_dpo_required == true)

name: Notify the Commissioner of a personal data breach

references.title: Personal Data Protection Act 2010 s.12B(1), (3) as inserted by Act A1727, in force 1 June 2025 (https://lom.agc.gov.my/ilims/upload/portal/akta/outputaktap/3301061_BI/Act%20709%20(Reprint%202026).pdf, read 2026-10-07); Personal Data Protection Commissioner, Guideline on Data Breach Notification paras 6.1, 14.1 (https://www.pdp.gov.my/ppdpv1/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/GP_DBN_ENG.pdf, read 2026-10-07).

definition.description: Notify the Personal Data Protection Commissioner of a personal data breach as soon as practicable and no later than 72 hours from its occurrence (opened_on = the day it occurred or was detected), and keep it in the breach register for at least two years from the notification. Record the notification day as facts.commissioner_notified_on. Raised when a PERSONAL_DATA_BREACH case is opened.

name: Notify affected employees of a personal data breach

references.title: Personal Data Protection Act 2010 s.12B(2) as inserted by Act A1727 (https://lom.agc.gov.my/ilims/upload/portal/akta/outputaktap/3301061_BI/Act%20709%20(Reprint%202026).pdf, read 2026-10-07); Guideline on Data Breach Notification paras 8.1, 9.1 (https://www.pdp.gov.my/ppdpv1/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/GP_DBN_ENG.pdf, read 2026-10-07).

definition.description: Where the breach causes or is likely to cause significant harm (facts.significant_harm), notify each affected data subject without unnecessary delay and not later than seven days after the notification to the Commissioner (facts.commissioner_notified_on). Raised when both are recorded on the PERSONAL_DATA_BREACH case.

name: Inquire into a sexual harassment complaint

definition.description: Inquire into a complaint of sexual harassment in the prescribed manner; or, refusing to inquire (previously inquired and not proven, or frivolous, vexatious or not in good faith), inform the complainant in writing of the refusal and its reasons as soon as practicable and not later than thirty days after receiving the complaint (opened_on). Raised when a SEXUAL_HARASSMENT_COMPLAINT case is opened.

name: Inquire when directed by the Director General and report

definition.description: When the Director General directs the employer to inquire into a complaint (on a referral of the employer's refusal, s.81B(5)(a), or a complaint made to the Director General, s.81D(1)), inquire and submit the report of the inquiry within thirty days of the direction (facts.dg_directed_on on the SEXUAL_HARASSMENT_COMPLAINT case).

name: Act on a proven sexual harassment finding

definition.description: Where the employer's inquiry proves sexual harassment (facts.inquiry_outcome PROVEN): against an employee, take disciplinary action (dismissal without notice, downgrading, or a lesser punishment, suspension without wages at most two weeks); against a non-employee, recommend the person be brought before the appropriate disciplinary authority. Raised on the case update recording the finding; due that day.

name: Inform the Director General of a foreign domestic employee

definition.description: Inform the Director General of Labour of the employment of a foreign domestic employee within thirty days of the employment (separate from the s.60K particulars; it applies to domestic employees although Part XII does not). Raised where the terms record a FOREIGNER on a DOMESTIC employment.
definition.applies_when:
contract != null && has(contract.facts) && contract.facts != null
&&has(contract.facts.contract_terms)
&&contract.facts.contract_terms.exists(
  t,
  has(t.residency_status) && t.residency_status == "FOREIGNER"
  &&has(t.employment_type)
  &&t.employment_type == "DOMESTIC"
)

name: Inform the Director General of a foreign domestic employee's termination

definition.description: Inform the Director General of Labour within thirty days of the termination of a foreign domestic employee's service — by the employer, by the employee (absconding included), on the expiry of the employment pass, or by repatriation or deportation.
definition.applies_when:
contract != null && has(contract.facts) && contract.facts != null
&&has(contract.facts.contract_terms)
&&contract.facts.contract_terms.exists(
  t,
  has(t.residency_status) && t.residency_status == "FOREIGNER"
  &&has(t.employment_type)
  &&t.employment_type == "DOMESTIC"
)

name: CP58 statement for an agent whose engagement ended

definition.description: The CP58 statement of the year's payments for an agent, dealer or distributor whose engagement ends during the year (the January tick reaches only engagements still in force): raised on the engagement's end for a PAYEE whose terms record an AGENT, DEALER or DISTRIBUTOR role, once for the year it ends; due 31 March of the next year.
definition.when:
contract != null && contract.exit_facts != null
&&contract.effective_range.to != null
&&has(contract.engagement)
&&contract.engagement == "PAYEE"
&&has(contract.facts)
&&contract.facts != null
&&has(contract.facts.contract_terms)
&&contract.facts.contract_terms.exists(
  t,
  has(t.facts) && t.facts != null && has(t.facts.payee_role)
  &&t.facts.payee_role in ["AGENT", "DEALER", "DISTRIBUTOR"]
)

name: FOMEMA medical examination of a new foreign worker

references.title: Immigration Department of Malaysia, Foreign Worker service page (https://www.imi.gov.my/index.php/en/main-services/foreign-worker/, read 2026-10-07): "employers are given a period of 30 days to conduct health examination of foreign workers at the registered health centre with FOMEMA"; Immigration Act 1959/63 and Immigration Regulations 1963 (visit pass conditions).

definition.description: Have the foreign worker examined at a FOMEMA-registered health centre and certified fit within 30 days (the Visit Pass (Temporary Employment) is issued only after it); repeat at the 2nd- and 3rd-year renewals (WORK_PASS_RENEWAL). Raised where the terms record a FOREIGNER; due 30 days after the start (taken as arrival).
definition.applies_when:
contract != null && has(contract.facts) && contract.facts != null
&&has(contract.facts.contract_terms)
&&contract.facts.contract_terms.exists(
  t,
  has(t.residency_status) && t.residency_status == "FOREIGNER"
)

definition.description: Of the eleven gazetted holidays the employer grants, five are compulsory: National Day, the Yang di-Pertuan Agong's birthday, the Ruler's birthday or Federal Territory Day of the State, Workers' Day and Malaysia Day. Raised on the December run when the published holidays of the next twelve months lack any of the four federal ones (Hari Kebangsaan, Hari Keputeraan Rasmi Seri Paduka Baginda Yang di-Pertuan Agong, Hari Pekerja, Hari Malaysia); the state Ruler's birthday or Federal Territory Day is the employer's state row to confirm.

effect:
calendar.exists(c, has(c.rules.holidays))

  ).map(

name: Every obligation row's program
effect:
[
  {
    "code": behaviour.code,
    "name": behaviour.name,
    "references": behaviour.references,
    "rules": behaviour.definition
  }
].filter(
  d,
  (!has(d.rules.months)
  ||d.rules.months.exists(m, event.period.key.endsWith("-" + m)))
  && (!has(d.rules.applies_when)
  ||configured_eval(
    d.rules.applies_when,
    {
      "period": event.period,
      "rules": event.rules,
      "company": first(company),
      "run": run,
      "holidays": holidays.map(h, h.date),
      "holidays_named": holidays.filter(
        h,
        h.date >= event.day && h.date <= add_months(event.day, 12)
      ).map(
        h,
        {
          "date": h.date,
          "name": has(h.name) ? h.name : "",
          "kind": h.kind
        }
      )
    }
  )
  ==true)
  &&!raised.exists(o, o.duty_code == d.code)
).map(
  d,
  {
    "collection": "obligation",
    "operation": "create",
    "data": {
      "duty_code": d.code,
      "references": d.references,
      "company_id": event.company_id,
      "settings_id": event.settings_id,
      "trigger_ref": event.row.id,
      "triggered_on": event.day,
      "due_on": configured_eval(
        d.rules.due,
        {
          "period": event.period,
          "rules": event.rules,
          "company": first(company),
          "run": run,
          "holidays": holidays.map(h, h.date),
          "holidays_named": holidays.filter(
            h,
            h.date >= event.day && h.date <= add_months(event.day, 12)
          ).map(
            h,
            {
              "date": h.date,
              "name": has(h.name) ? h.name : "",
              "kind": h.kind
            }
          )
        }
      ),
      "amount_due": has(d.rules.amount)
        ?configured_eval(
          d.rules.amount,
          {
            "rules": event.rules,
            "total": sum(
              d.rules.schemes.map(
                s,
                s in run.totals.schemes
                  ?run.totals.schemes[s].employee
                  +run.totals.schemes[s].employer
                  :0.0
              )
            ),
            "run": run,
            "period": event.period,
            "company": first(company),
            "headcount_months": event.headcount_months
          }
        )
        :round(
          sum(
            d.rules.schemes.map(
              s,
              s in run.totals.schemes
                ?run.totals.schemes[s].employee
                +run.totals.schemes[s].employer
                :0.0
            )
          ),
          0.01
        ),
      "occurrence_key": d.code + ":" + event.row.id
    }
  }
).filter(
  w,
  w.data.amount_due > 0.0
)
